read.thesis: Record $20.5B quarter and $72B backlog (up 92% y/y) with 1.5 GW recip restart and Wamego repurposing; supply is expanding but gated by production, with P&E lead times into late 2028.

capex.quote: Our CapEx spend for 2026 is anticipated to be approximately $3.5 billion similar to our previous expectations.

triggers.label: FY26 sales growth raised to mid-to-high teens
triggers.quote: We are increasing our full year 2026 sales and revenues expectations to mid- to high teens growth
triggers.highlight: increasing our full year 2026 sales and revenues expectations

triggers.label: Power gen STU up 72%
triggers.quote: Power generation grew 72%, driven by very strong demand for large gensets and turbines used in data center applications.

triggers.label: Restarting 1.5 GW recip line
triggers.quote: We plan to bring about 1.5 gigawatts of capacity back online, and shipments are expected to begin in the fourth quarter.
triggers.highlight: bring about 1.5 gigawatts of capacity back online

triggers.label: CI dealer inventory up $400M
triggers.quote: Dealer inventory increased by $400 million in Construction Industries compared to a decrease in the second quarter of 2025.
